CRYENGINE | Documentation - Volumetric Fog
Voxel-based Volumetric Fog consists of two parts; 1: ray-marching Volumetric Fog and 2: analytical Volumetric Fog. Ray-marching Volumetric Fog handles all types of light and differing fog densities, while analytical Volumetric Fog handles sun light without dynamic shadow and exponential height fog density.
